minutes.headline: Planning Board approved an ANR at 828 Lancaster Ave and 525 Chase Road with conditions, and named two master plan members.
minutes.summary: The Planning Board approved an ANR plan for 828 Lancaster Ave and, after closing the hearing, approved the 525 Chase Road site plan with conditions on chambers, soil testing and hours. It appointed two at-large members to the master plan steering committee and discussed the community engagement plan, the select board's representative seat, and the proposed aquifer protection bylaw (which would drop Zone 1 and Zone 3 regulation). Four sets of minutes were approved and committee reports heard.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved an ANR plan for 828 Lancaster Ave by voice vote.
After closing the public hearing, the board approved the 525 Chase Road site plan with conditions on drainage chambers, soil testing and working hours.
The board appointed two at-large members, Gerald Reed and Josie Gilchrist, to the master plan steering committee.
The board will have the planner write to the select board saying it wants its representative on the steering committee to be an active select board member.
The proposed aquifer protection bylaw was discussed with no resolution; the planner is to send a zone map and a link to the bylaws.

why_it_matters: The 525 Chase Road approval sets the drainage, soil-testing and hours conditions that will govern construction on that site.
The master plan steering committee is now staffed, and it will shape the town's long-range plan that residents are asked to weigh in on through surveys and a website.
The aquifer protection bylaw, as discussed, would change which water-supply zones are regulated, so a future town meeting vote could affect protection of the town's groundwater.
watch_next: The planner's letter to the select board on its representative seat, and the zone map and bylaw link for the aquifer protection bylaw.
A joint meeting with the open space committee when the next first right of refusal arises.
